algorithm: CA-BOSS v4.47 cross-block empirical-null reporter synchronization

method_contract.state_source: held-out background features within each assay
method_contract.contexts: full fit plus two disjoint background-feature folds
method_contract.reporter_stability: within-assay cell bootstraps evaluated separately in each context
method_contract.multi_assay_registration: exact minimum-total pairwise-KS permutation synchronization over the eligible rank-three assay components
method_contract.ordinary_support_gate: a candidate assay pair requires ordinary statistical support in at least two of three contexts
method_contract.edge_specific_score: minimum held-out coassigned global-assignment pair-exclusion relative margin
method_contract.crossfit_calibration: for each target seed block, set the threshold to the maximum eligible null score in all other cached seed blocks and select target pairs strictly above it
method_contract.guarded_union: union calibrated pairs with v4.46 truth-blind guarded pairs, then deduplicate
method_contract.conflict_handling: merge selected assay pairs sharing an assay into one connected, unexpanded ambiguity hyperedge
method_contract.claim_scope: shared-state equivalence only; never claim within-assay direct structure, exact cross-assay causal direction, or expansion of candidate alternatives

calibration_audit.note: The one point-selected null pair shares an assay with a selected true pair and is retained only as an alternative inside one two-pair ambiguity hyperedge; it is not emitted as a standalone edge. Hyperedge precision therefore does not assert that every candidate alternative is true.

published_method_inspiration.primary: Sturma, Squires, Drton, and Uhler (NeurIPS 2023), Unpaired Multi-Domain Causal Representation Learning
published_method_inspiration.permutation_synchronization: Pachauri, Kondor, and Singh (NeurIPS 2013), Solving the Multi-way Matching Problem by Permutation Synchronization
published_method_inspiration.multiway_matching: Tang and Jebara (AISTATS 2017), Initialization and Coordinate Optimization for Multi-way Matching
published_method_inspiration.relationship: CA-BOSS adapts multi-domain component matching and permutation-consistency ideas to sparse count assays with held-out background-state proxies. The implementation is not a theorem application, and no publication contributes data or a biological pairing prior.
